skill.name: opensource-guide-coach

content.value_statement: Open source maintainers often need focused advice without reading every guide. This skill maps each situation to official guides and practical next steps.
actual_capabilities: Routes open source questions to the smallest useful set of official guide topics.
Infers the likely maintainer persona, project stage, and main pain point.
Recommends one to three official Open Source Guides with canonical URLs.
Turns guide themes into prioritized next steps for the project size.
Calls out scope risks, legal boundaries, and over-process concerns.
Preserves attribution and avoids long copied passages from source guides.
limitations: It gives general guidance and does not replace legal advice from a qualified lawyer.
It is not a GitHub product documentation assistant for feature-specific tasks.
It does not provide deep code-level security review or incident response.
It relies on bundled guide mappings and may not reflect future guide changes.

use_cases.title: Prepare a First Open Source Launch
use_cases.description: Help a solo developer decide what to prepare before opening a project to contributors.

use_cases.title: Improve Contributor Onboarding
use_cases.description: Help a maintainer simplify contribution paths and choose practical community improvements.

use_cases.title: Plan Governance and Sustainability
use_cases.description: Help a team balance decision rules, conduct expectations, funding, and maintainer capacity.

prompt_templates.title: Check Launch Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new project.
prompt_templates.prompt: I want to open source my project. Help me decide what I need before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Contributor Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Maintainer wants clearer first contribution paths.
prompt_templates.prompt: Our project has interested users but few contributors. Suggest practical onboarding improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Reduce Maintainer Overload
prompt_templates.scenario: Maintainer needs process and boundary guidance.
prompt_templates.prompt: I am overwhelmed by issues and pull requests. Recommend a lightweight plan that protects maintainer time.

prompt_templates.title: Balance Governance and Trust
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a mature project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Our mature open source project needs clearer governance, security expectations, and sustainability planning. Recommend the most relevant guide path.

output_examples.input: Should I open source my internal tool now?
output: Identifies the user as an early-stage project owner.
Recommends Starting an Open Source Project and Finding Users for Your Project.
Lists launch preparation steps and warns against over-promising support.

output_examples.input: Our project has many issues and I feel burned out.
output: Routes the question to maintainer best practices and balance guidance.
Suggests triage boundaries, clearer expectations, and a smaller support surface.
Keeps recommendations practical for volunteer maintainers.

output_examples.input: We need rules for decisions and community behavior.
output: Connects governance and code of conduct topics without drafting a full charter by default.
Explains why each official guide applies.
Adds watch-outs about excessive process for small projects.

best_practices: Share the project stage, maintainer capacity, and main pain point in the prompt.
Ask for one concrete plan before requesting full policy or governance drafts.
Treat legal and security answers as general guidance unless expert review is available.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill as a substitute for legal counsel on licensing disputes.
Do not ask for every guide topic when one focused guide would solve the problem.
Do not request heavyweight governance for a small project without a real decision problem.

faq.question: What sources does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses the official Open Source Guides site and bundled guide maps for routing and attribution.

faq.question: Can it write project documents?
faq.answer: Yes, when explicitly asked. By default it gives advice, guide links, and next steps.

faq.question: Does it provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It can explain general open source legal concepts and suggest when expert help is needed.

faq.question: Does it help with security?
faq.answer: It covers maintainer-level security practices, disclosure expectations, and trust signals, not code-level review.

faq.question: Is it only for new projects?
faq.answer: No. It also supports growing projects, overloaded maintainers, shared governance, and sustainability planning.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
